critical_code_review_comments: AlertDialog implementation correctly replaces window.confirm in all 5 modules
Each module has proper state management (deleteConfirmOpen, deleteXData) for modal control
handleDelete function sets the entity data and opens the modal
executeDelete function performs the actual DELETE API call after confirmation
Error handling correctly shows toast.error with backend error message when referential integrity fails
Success toast shows 'X eliminado exitosamente' message after successful deletion
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test entities (client, bank, service, hardware, integrator) during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All AlertDialog confirmation modals for DELETE operations are working correctly in all 5 modules. Backend DELETE endpoints have proper referential integrity validation that returns HTTP 400 with descriptive error messages when linked records exist. The toast notifications show success/error messages appropriately. There is a minor cosmetic hydration warning in React about table structure but it doesn't affect functionality.
